overall_notes: This paper describes a system for automatically verifying factual accuracy of machine-generated sports summaries. The approach combines rule-based methods (WED) for detecting word/name errors with a neural model (NED) for detecting number errors. The evaluation is entirely automated using error detection accuracy metrics. The paper does not use LLMs as judges or conduct human evaluations.
